notes: Agent successfully delivered all acceptance criteria: user board script runs without errors, handles required commands, session persistence works, and gracefully manages service availability. Tests pass and FLIP verification (0.73) confirms solid code intent. However, multiple coredrift yellow flags on scope_drift and churn_loc indicate the agent exceeded LOC budget or modified files outside the touch specification, then proceeded without addressing these constraint violations. The agent should have proactively reverted out-of-scope changes or requested expanded touch globs when warnings appeared. Work is functionally complete and production-ready, but constraint management was loose. Task completed in ~4.5 minutes with no downstream blocking issues. Strengths: correctness, completeness, graceful error handling. Weaknesses: unaddressed scope/budget drift, insufficient responsiveness to coredrift signals.
